'''Soolami''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and younger sister of [[Sadelli]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Soolami was a slave under [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavemaster [[Woff B'tar]]. Just before being shipped off to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], her older sister escaped, and was escorted safely back to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] with a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[JillJoo Jab]]. However, Sadelli refused to leave the planet without Soolami.<ref name="SWG" />

The spacer was once again sent by JillJoo Jab, this time to rescue Soolami, who was being escorted by a thug and a Trandoshan slaver. Soolami was then escorted safely back to the [[City/Legends|city]], allowing both siblings to leave the planet together.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Soolami is [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who perform a series of quests for JillJoo Jab in Mos Espa must find Soolami and bring her back to the city safely.
